name: metr_point_v0_graph_redirect_half
rationale: The unsupported adaptive graph is replaced halfway by the average of the existing forward/backward physical graph powers. For each graph power, add one quarter of its learned adaptive channel matrix to each corresponding physical channel matrix and retain one half on the adaptive branch. All supports are row-normalized, so this preserves the response to spatially constant features at both noise levels, unlike simply attenuating adaptive weights. It tests whether redirecting random spatial mixing toward the supplied road graph helps without changing the common activation. This edit is derived entirely from existing weights and graph structure; no target values are used.
